responsibility: This header declares the exported `function_base` objects that represent SME intrinsic semantics inside the AArch64 SVE builtin framework. It provides one extern declaration per SME operation in `namespace aarch64_sve::functions`, such as ZA arithmetic, ZA/ZT loads and stores, reads, writes, zeroing, and state queries, so the central builtin-registration code can attach the declarative entries from `aarch64-sve-builtins-sme.def` to the implementations in `aarch64-sve-builtins-sme.cc`.
same_name_distinction: Among the `aarch64-sve-builtins-sme` files, this header is the interface declaration layer: it exports `extern const function_base *const` declarations in `aarch64_sve::functions` so other SVE builtin code can refer to SME handlers, unlike the `.cc` file that defines those handlers and the `.def` file that enumerates intrinsic families and feature requirements.
